requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter while using basketry tools and materials, and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. (b) Discuss the prevention of and first-aid treatment for injuries, including cuts, scratches, and scrapes, that could occur while working with basketry tools and materials.

pamphlet_excerpts: Basketry Sub-Req 1a: Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter while using basketry tools and materials, and what you should do to.
Basketry Sub-Req 1b: Discuss the prevention of and first-aid treatment for injuries, including cuts, scratches, and scrapes, that could occur while working with basketry tools and materials.

Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter while using basketry tools and materials, and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards.
Core Standard 2 (Req 1): (b) Discuss the prevention of and first-aid treatment for injuries, including cuts, scratches, and scrapes, that could occur while working with basketry tools and materials.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 1): Review the official Basketry requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you.
Execute & Document: Perform the demonstrate task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Basketry Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
